def test_flip_case():

    assert flip_case("Hello") == "hELLO"
    assert flip_case("Hello World") == "hELLO wORLD"

    # All lowercase
    assert flip_case("python") == "PYTHON"

    # All uppercase
    assert flip_case("PYTHON") == "python"

    # Empty string
    assert flip_case("") == ""

    # Single character
    assert flip_case("a") == "A"
    assert flip_case("A") == "a"

    # String with no letters (digits, punctuation, spaces)
    assert flip_case("12345!@# ") == "12345!@# "

    # Already flipped string returns to original
    assert flip_case(flip_case("MiXeD CaSe")) == "MiXeD CaSe"

    # Unicode letters
    assert flip_case("ñÁç") == "ÑáÇ"
